title: 40GB wp_options autoload: the night we hit 800ms TTFB
lede: A Loom link at 23:41, a homepage TTFB over eight seconds, and a wp_options table that had quietly grown to 40GB. The fix was three SQL statements and a long night.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: MySQL run-sheet, phpMyAdmin printout, TTFB chart, manila tab, brass plate, wax seal.
